mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drinks ( drink_id, drink_name, image_url, status, is_deleted, drink_category_id, shop_id ) VALUES ( #{drinkId}, #{drinkName}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, #{drinkCategoryId}, #{shopId} )
INSERT INTO drink_details ( drink_detail_id, size, price, drink_id ) VALUES ( #{drinkDetailId}, #{size}, #{price}, #{drinkId} )
